name: gharsathi-fullstack
description: Ghar Sathi - Production Full-Stack Home Services Platform

scripts.build: npm --prefix GharSathi_React run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('GharSathi_React/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); console.log('? Successfully copied dist/ to root for Firebase Hosting.');"
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
